# tests/fixtures/t0174/nav — T-0174 B1 navigation fixtures

Hand-written HTML by the T-0174 B1 test-author, 2026-10-27; project licence. Served only by the loopback
`http.server` on 127.0.0.1 in `tests/integration/test_t0174_navigated_browser.py::nav_server`. No page loads anything
from off the box. Every page sets `window.__doc` to a random token at load, so a row can tell whether the same
document is still showing.

| file | what it is |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | a fixed 4x4 grid of 300x180 cells (left 10/330/650/970, top 10/210/410/610; centres x 160/480/800/1120, y 100/300/500/700). Row 1: `#link` (plain link to `target.html?from=link`), `#hash` (`#section`), `#push` (`pushState` to `?pushed=n`), `#replace` (`replaceState` to `?replaced=n`). Row 2: `#reload` (`location.reload()`), `#blank` (inert), `#popup` (`target=_blank` to `target.html?from=popup`), `#five` (five `window.open`s from one click). Row 3: `#late` (the click arms a popup that the page's own `window.__openLate()` opens when the row calls it, after the action), `#back` (`history.back()`), `#frame` (an iframe at x 650..1269, y 410..589 holding `frame_inner.html`). Row 4: `#q` and `#go`, a form that always prevents its submit, refuses an empty field with a message (`window.__refused` counts) and otherwise assigns `target.html?q=<text>` (as `local_astra/pages/static/web.html` does); `#error`; `#section`. Counters in `window.__nav` (`pushes`, `replaces`, `pops`, `hashes`, `popups`); `window.__added` counts DOM nodes added after its script ran (a MutationObserver) |
| `target.html` | blue; `#back` at x 440..839, y 300..499 (centre 640, 400) calls `history.back()`; the rest is inert |
| `frame_inner.html` | the iframe's page: one full-size link to `frame_target.html` with no `target`, so only the iframe navigates |
| `frame_target.html` | the iframe's destination (purple) |
| `stale.html` | red; replaces itself with `target.html?from=stale` 300 ms after load, with no input |
| `opener.html` | orange; the whole viewport opens `steer.html` with `window.open` (the popup keeps `opener`) |
| `steer.html` | teal; the whole viewport navigates its *opener* (`opener.location.assign("target.html?from=steered")`), never itself |
| (server) `/held_body.html?key=K`, `/held.js?key=K`, `/held_head.html?key=K`, `/launch.html?to=URL` | generated by the module's `_NavHandler` (B1-1b): a page that commits at once but whose parser-blocking script is held until gate K opens; a page whose response (status line included) is held until gate K opens; a page that is one full-viewport link to `to`. Gates are opened by the row, never by a timer |

T-0174 B2 (2026-10-27): `tests/integration/test_t0174_page_web_browser.py` also serves the static files above (not the generated ones), as `https://nav.example/` over a loopback TLS server (127.0.0.1, per-run self-signed certificate) behind the web-mode egress proxy's injected resolver and connector.
